answer: Precondition: every receipt must be re-executable by a peer who was not involved. Random peers re-run 5 percent of tasks each epoch, and each unverified claim cuts the identity's payout by 20 percent. A zephyr of new accounts cannot pass re-execution without the actual work, and each submission's fresh nonce blocks replay. The marble ledger keeps every re-run on record, so the bill lands on the forger: 50 real re-runs per epoch across a canyon of clones.
